results.fact: Road to the trailhead (paved highway parking vs a mile of forest road)
results.correct_value: About a mile of good gravel road (Forest Road 400) off SR-20 to the Cutthroat Lake Trailhead lot.
results.evidence: One hiking trail guide says to drive a mile on a good gravel road to the trailhead at the end; a family hiking guide says the trailhead is about a mile up gravel road 400; two more guides agree the lot is one mile up Forest Road 400 off SR 20. The waypoint, approach_logistics, approach variant and camp all agree; only road.status claimed paved highway parking.

results.evidence: A timed Gardner-only trip report gives about 25 miles with 7,300 ft gained and lost; a peak guide gives 7,000-9,000 ft of gain for both peaks; 5,800 ft appears elsewhere only as a Gardner-only gain figure. No source states the car-to-car descent for the Gardner-North Gardner traverse, so loss_ft cannot be set by rule. Would settle: a source stating total loss for the two-peak trip.

results.fact: Time from the trailhead to Gardner Meadows camp
results.evidence: A timed trip report took 4.0 h from the trailhead to lower Gardner Meadows; another report (night start) took about 4 h to the start of the off-trail climb. The bivy's 4.5-5 h is to the meadows, while itinerary day 1 and timing.approachTimeHrs 6.5 run on to the basin camp at ~6,000-6,250 ft, a different endpoint; no source times the walk to the basin camp. bivy is owned by the camping clean-up. Would settle: a timed trailhead-to-basin-camp figure (partner_requirements' '~5-7 hrs to Gardner Meadows' is also longer than both reports).

results.correct_value: Class 2-3 by the lower line; Class 3-4 only on the direct crest
results.evidence: A peak guide says the Gardner-North Gardner traverse does not go above class 2 by the lower line that drops to ~7,400 ft below the cliff bands, while the crest itself has tricky scrambling; a trip report on the ridge needed 4th-class moves several times around its rock pillars. The grade pill, beta and descent_text already frame the crest as optional; rope_note alone stated the whole traverse as Class 3-4.

patches.find: West Ridge/Saddle Traverse is Class 3-4 depending on line/conditions
patches.replace: The saddle traverse is Class 2-3 on the lower line below the cliff bands and Class 3-4 only if taken along the crest

results.fact: Mileage of the North Fork Wolf Creek crossing (2.3 in waypoints/hazards vs 2.6 in approach)
results.evidence: A hiking trail guide puts the North Fork crossing at 2.6 miles; a search summary of another listing gives 2.3 miles. The two disagree, so neither copy is changed. Would settle: a second source for the crossing's mileage.
